title: Reefer Cargo Services: Excursion Credit Rates, Caps and Reporting Windows
content:
The terms on which a Reefer Cargo Services tier compensates a temperature excursion are fixed per tier: the credit rate as a whole percentage of the credit basis, the ceiling on any one credit in US dollars, the list of charges that make up the credit basis, the reporting window in calendar days after delivery, and the number of credits one service can receive.

| Tier | Credit rate (% of credit basis) | Ceiling per credit (USD) | Reporting window after delivery (calendar days) | Credits available per service |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 25 | 250.00 | 14 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 50 | 750.00 | 21 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 50 | 900.00 | 21 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 100 | 2500.00 | 30 | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 50 | 1500.00 | 21 | 1 |

## Charges forming the credit basis

The credit basis list is identical on all six tiers. It is made up of the charges booked to the service under these codes:

- plug-in and monitoring charges at the terminals;
- the remote monitoring fee;
- the cold treatment fee;
- the controlled atmosphere surcharge;
- the GDP handling fee;
- the superfreezer surcharge.

Because the list is closed, a charge booked under any other code, such as an inspection fee, a late request fee, a cancellation fee or a setting change fee, forms no part of the basis.

## Observations from the table

- Standard shows zero in every column and grants no excursion credit.
- Pharma GDP is the only tier offering two credits on one service and the only one crediting the full basis.
- Cold Treatment, Controlled Atmosphere and Superfreezer share the 50 percent rate and the 21-day window but have different ceilings.
